title: Business & Financial Disputes
description: Partnerships that break down, invoices that never get paid, shareholders who can't agree — the disputes that do the most damage to a small business. We help you assess the evidence and the odds before deciding whether to negotiate or sue.
intro: The deciding factor in a business dispute is usually not who is right, but who has evidence that holds up and who hasn't missed a deadline. Many Chinese-owned businesses run on trust and verbal agreements, so when things go wrong the contract is incomplete, transfers have no memo line, and the record lives scattered across WeChat. We start by turning what you have into a usable evidence chain, then assess whether recovery is realistic and at what cost. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
